$comment: Hand-edited input for tools/build-manifest.mjs. Everything here is merged on top of the data pulled from each addon repo's package.json / GitHub metadata. Edit this file, never manifest.json.

registry.name: Polyphase Engine Official Addons
registry.description: Official addon registry for the Polyphase Engine. Machine-readable index of every official addon, its metadata, dependencies and download locations, so the engine and tooling never have to crawl GitHub to resolve an addon.

categories.name: Editor
categories.description: Editor-side tooling, windows and authoring workflows.

categories.name: Formats
categories.description: Media and file format support (audio, video, capture).

categories.name: Build Targets
categories.description: Additional platform build targets for the Polyphase editor.

HelloWorld.name: Hello World
HelloWorld.summary: A minimal addon example with a single Text Widget.
HelloWorld.description: Minimal Polyphase project demonstrating the smallest possible addon: a single Text Widget rendered on screen. Intended as a starting point for new addon authors.

com.polyphase.engine.fps.name: Polyphase FPS
com.polyphase.engine.fps.summary: Core first-person controller and gameplay framework for FPS-style projects.

com.polyphase.engine.combat.core.name: Polyphase Combat Core
com.polyphase.engine.combat.core.description: Core combat framework for Polyphase. Damage, hit resolution and combat state shared by the FPS and RPG systems.
com.polyphase.engine.combat.core.author: Polyphase Labs

com.polyphase.system.character.dialogue..name: Polyphase Dialogue Core
com.polyphase.system.character.dialogue..summary: Core character dialogue system for driving in-engine conversations.

com.polyphase.system.items.core.summary: Core item system for defining, storing, and managing in-game items.

com.polyphase.editor.levelbuilder.core.summary: Core level builder framework for creating and managing levels.

com.polyphase.formats.midi.name: Polyphase MIDI

com.polyphase.formats.video.name: Polyphase Video Player
